# Jurivo

> Jurivo is a specialist digital design and growth agency for established South African law firms. Jurivo is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

Canonical website: https://www.jurivo.co.za/
Language: English (South Africa)
Geographic market: South Africa

## Primary pages

- [Jurivo homepage](https://www.jurivo.co.za/): Law firm websites, search visibility, conversion optimisation, analytics and enquiry systems.
- [Law firm SEO South Africa](https://www.jurivo.co.za/services/law-firm-seo-south-africa): Technical, local and practice-area SEO for established South African legal practices.
- [Website strategy call](https://www.jurivo.co.za/strategy-call): A focused working session for law firms ready to move on a new website or redesign.

## Core services

- Law firm positioning and website strategy
- Law firm website design and development
- Technical, local and practice-area SEO
- Conversion optimisation and analytics
- Enquiry tracking and automation

## How Jurivo works

Jurivo diagnoses the firm’s current market position, website experience, search visibility, conversion paths, analytics and enquiry handling before recommending work. Jurivo does not publish guaranteed rankings, invented performance statistics or automated audit claims.

## Audience

The primary audience is decision-makers at established South African law firms who want a stronger digital presence and more qualified enquiry opportunities.
